capabilities: Render tree code blocks as ASCII trees in editing and preview modes
Detect hierarchy from markdown lists or = sign indentation
Wrap the current selection or line in a tree code block
Convert tree code blocks back to plain text
Configure connector dash width and trailing folder slashes per block or globally
disambiguation: Does not generate folder trees from the vault's file system; it only transforms text written in a tree code block.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn indented hierarchies into formatted ASCII tree diagrams with box-drawing characters.
summary: Tree diagram renderer that converts indented markdown lists or = sign hierarchy markers in tree code blocks into ASCII tree diagrams.
